description: Default permissions. fs scope is deliberately limited to APPDATA + Documents + Downloads + Desktop + ~/Library/CloudStorage (cloud drives such as Synology Drive, where the user's working data and backup folders live); dialog/drag-drop picks extend it per-session. The webview cannot execute shell commands: Apple Mail sharing, Calendar sync and PDF/HEIC extraction run as dedicated Rust commands with fixed scripts (src-tauri/src/apple.rs); shell:allow-open remains for opening URLs in the browser.
